title: Lesson 2: 真正的朋友 (zhēn zhèng de péng yǒu) (True Friends)

vocabulary.meaning: adv. just in time, just right

grammar.explanation: “正好” can be used as an adjective to mean “just right”, indicating that a condition in terms of time, position, size, quantity, degree, etc. is met. It can also be used as an adverb to mean “it is the right time or opportunity to do something”.

formal_examples.chinese: 苹果八块五，西瓜十一块五，正好二十块。
formal_examples.pinyin: Píngguǒ bā kuài wǔ, xīguā shíyī kuài wǔ, zhènghǎo èrshí kuài.
formal_examples.translation: The apples are eight yuan fifty, and the watermelon is eleven yuan fifty, exactly twenty yuan.

formal_examples.chinese: 你来得正好，我的钱包不见了，借我点儿钱吧。
formal_examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái de zhènghǎo, wǒ de qiánbāo bú jiàn le, jiè wǒ diǎnr qián ba.
formal_examples.translation: You came at just the right time. My wallet is missing; lend me a little money.

formal_examples.chinese: 我们下午要去踢足球，正好一起去吧。
formal_examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ yào qù tī zúqiú, zhènghǎo yìqǐ qù ba.
formal_examples.translation: We are going to play football this afternoon; it is a good opportunity for us to go together.

formal_examples.chinese: 我妹妹出生那天，正好下雪，所以爸爸妈妈叫她“小雪”。
formal_examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei chūshēng nà tiān, zhènghǎo xià xuě, suǒyǐ bàba māma jiào tā “Xiǎoxuě”.
formal_examples.translation: On the day my younger sister was born, it happened to snow, so my parents called her “Xiaoxue”.

grammar.colloquial_pattern: 赶得早不如赶得巧 / 凑巧

colloquial_examples.chinese: 咱下午去踢球, 你来得正好, 凑巧一块儿呗。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Zán xiàwǔ qù tīqiú, nǐ láide zhènghǎo, còuqiǎo yīkuàir bei.
colloquial_examples.translation: We're playing ball this afternoon. You came at just the right time, let's just go together.

grammar.nuance: Using '凑巧' (coincidentally) or ending with '呗' makes it sound more casual and friendly among peers.

grammar.explanation: “差不多” can be used as an adjective to mean “approximate” and “without much difference”. It can also be used as an adverb to indicate being close in terms of degree, scope, time, distance or quantity.

formal_examples.chinese: 这两个电子词典看上去差不多，左边这个怎么这么贵？
formal_examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge diànzǐ cídiǎn kàn shàngqù chàbuduō, zuǒbian zhè ge zěnme zhème guì?
formal_examples.translation: These two electronic dictionaries look about the same. Why is the one on the left so expensive?

formal_examples.chinese: 他们俩是在国外旅游的时候认识的，性格差不多，所以很快就成了好朋友。
formal_examples.pinyin: Tāmen liǎ shì zài guówài lǚyóu de shíhou rènshi de, xìnggé chàbuduō, suǒyǐ hěn kuài jiù chéngle hǎo péngyou.
formal_examples.translation: The two of them met while traveling abroad. Their personalities are similar, so they quickly became good friends.

formal_examples.chinese:
A: 班里同学你联系得怎么样了？来多少人？
B: 差不多一半儿吧。
formal_examples.pinyin:
A: Bānlǐ tóngxué nǐ liánxì de zěnmeyàng le? Lái duōshǎo rén?
B: Chàbuduō yíbànr ba.
formal_examples.translation:
A: How is contacting the classmates going? How many people are coming?
B: About half, I guess.

formal_examples.chinese: 女儿上中学后，个子长得特别快，现在都快一米七了，差不多跟我一样高了。
formal_examples.pinyin: Nǚ'ér shàng zhōngxué hòu, gèzi zhǎng de tèbié kuài, xiànzài dōu kuài yì mǐ qī le, chàbuduō gēn wǒ yíyàng gāo le.
formal_examples.translation: After my daughter started middle school, she grew very quickly. Now she is almost 1.7 meters tall, about as tall as me.

grammar.colloquial_pattern: 大差不差 (dà chā bù chā) / 基本上 (jīběn shàng)

colloquial_examples.chinese: 班里人联系得大差不差了，基本上能来一半儿。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Bānlǐ rén liánxì de dà chā bù chā le, jīběn shàng néng lái yībànr.
colloquial_examples.translation: The classmates are mostly contacted, basically about half can come.

grammar.nuance: '大差不差' is a more northern, idiomatic way to say 'almost there' or 'pretty much' in a colloquial setting.

grammar.explanation: Similarity: both “差不多” and “几乎” are adverbs indicating being very close or similar, and both can serve as an adverbial modifier. Differences: when expressing this meaning, “差不多” can be used directly before a monosyllabic adjective, while the adjective before or after “几乎” needs other words. “差不多” can precede a numeral-classifier compound to indicate being close to that quantity, while “几乎” has no such usage. “差不多” can also be used as an adjective predicate to indicate being similar and without much difference, while “几乎” has no such usage. “几乎” can indicate that something undesirable almost happened but finally did not, while “差不多” has no such usage.

formal_examples.chinese: 他汉语说得很好，差不多/几乎跟中国人一样。
formal_examples.pinyin: Tā Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo, chàbuduō/jīhū gēn Zhōngguórén yíyàng.
formal_examples.translation: He speaks Chinese very well, almost like a Chinese person.

formal_examples.chinese: 他们俩差不多高。
formal_examples.pinyin: Tāmen liǎ chàbuduō gāo.
formal_examples.translation: The two of them are about the same height.

formal_examples.chinese: 他们俩几乎一样高。
formal_examples.pinyin: Tāmen liǎ jīhū yíyàng gāo.
formal_examples.translation: The two of them are almost the same height.

formal_examples.chinese: 他比我几乎高了一头。
formal_examples.pinyin: Tā bǐ wǒ jīhū gāole yì tóu.
formal_examples.translation: He is almost a head taller than me.

formal_examples.chinese: 李老师差不多六十岁了。
formal_examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎoshī chàbuduō liùshí suì le.
formal_examples.translation: Teacher Li is almost sixty years old.

formal_examples.chinese: 姐妹俩性格差不多。
formal_examples.pinyin: Jiěmèi liǎ xìnggé chàbuduō.
formal_examples.translation: The two sisters have similar personalities.

formal_examples.chinese: 这件事我几乎忘了告诉你了。
formal_examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ jīhū wàngle gàosù nǐ le.
formal_examples.translation: I almost forgot to tell you about this.

grammar.colloquial_pattern: 差不多 / 几乎 / 差一点儿

colloquial_examples.chinese: 哎呀，我差一点儿就忘了跟你说这事儿了。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Āiyā, wǒ chà yīdiǎnr jiù wàngle gēn nǐ shuō zhè shìr le.
colloquial_examples.translation: Oops, I almost forgot to tell you about this matter.

grammar.nuance: This is a comparison note rather than a single new pattern. “差不多” can describe similarity or approximate quantity more freely, while “几乎” is better for “almost” as an adverb, especially when something nearly happened.

grammar.explanation: The conjunction “尽管” is usually used in the first clause of a complex sentence to state a fact, often coordinating with words indicating transition such as “但是/可是/却/还是” in the second clause, which introduces a result that would not occur under normal circumstances.

formal_examples.chinese: 尽管已经毕业这么多年，我们还是经常联系的。
formal_examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yǐjīng bìyè zhème duō nián, wǒmen háishì jīngcháng liánxì de.
formal_examples.translation: Although we have been graduated for many years, we still keep in regular contact.

formal_examples.chinese: 男朋友送给我的这份礼物尽管不贵，但却让我非常感动。
formal_examples.pinyin: Nán péngyou sòng gěi wǒ de zhè fèn lǐwù jǐnguǎn bú guì, dàn què ràng wǒ fēicháng gǎndòng.
formal_examples.translation: Although the gift my boyfriend gave me was not expensive, it moved me very much.

formal_examples.chinese: 叔叔最大的爱好就是打篮球，大学时他还多次参加校篮球比赛。尽管现在工作很忙，可到了周末他还是会跟朋友去打球。
formal_examples.pinyin: Shūshu zuì dà de àihào jiùshì dǎ lánqiú, dàxué shí tā hái duō cì cānjiā xiào lánqiú bǐsài. Jǐnguǎn xiànzài gōngzuò hěn máng, kě dào le zhōumò tā háishì huì gēn péngyou qù dǎ qiú.
formal_examples.translation: My uncle's biggest hobby is playing basketball, and in college he participated in school basketball games many times. Although he is very busy with work now, on weekends he still goes to play basketball with friends.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 虽说毕业好久了，咱俩这关系还是杠杠的，经常聚聚。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Suīshuō bìyè hǎojiǔ le, zán liǎ zhè guānxì háishì gànggàng de, jīngcháng jùju.
colloquial_examples.translation: Even though we graduated ages ago, our relationship is still solid; we get together often.

grammar.nuance: '虽说' is a very common oral substitute for '尽管' or '虽然'. Adding '杠杠的' (slang for excellent/solid) makes the sentence sound like a real conversation between close friends.

grammar.explanation: The adverb “却” is used after the subject and before the verb to indicate a transition in meaning in a softer tone.

formal_examples.chinese: 有人觉得有房子和汽车就是幸福，有人却认为找到真正的爱情才是幸福。
formal_examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén juéde yǒu fángzi hé qìchē jiùshì xìngfú, yǒu rén què rènwéi zhǎodào zhēnzhèng de àiqíng cái shì xìngfú.
formal_examples.translation: Some people think having a house and a car is happiness, while others believe finding true love is happiness.

formal_examples.chinese: 一个脾气不好的人虽然不一定让人讨厌，但是却很难跟人交朋友。
formal_examples.pinyin: Yīgè píqi bù hǎo de rén suīrán bù yīdìng ràng rén tǎoyàn, dànshì què hěn nán gēn rén jiāo péngyǒu.
formal_examples.translation: Although a person with a bad temper is not necessarily disliked, it is difficult for them to make friends.

formal_examples.chinese: 现在很多人虽然住在同一个楼里，但是却从来没说过话。
formal_examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō rén suīrán zhù zài tóng yí ge lóu lǐ, dànshì què cónglái méi shuō guò huà.
formal_examples.translation: Nowadays, many people live in the same building, yet they have never spoken to each other.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 住对门儿好几年，倒连个招呼都没打过，真是够尴尬的。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Zhù duìménr hǎojǐ nián, dào lián gè zhāohu dōu méi dǎ guò, zhēnshi gòu gāngà de.
colloquial_examples.translation: Living across from each other for years, yet not even a greeting was exchanged; it's quite awkward.

grammar.nuance: In spoken Chinese, '倒' is often used similarly to '却' to express something unexpected or contrary to expectation. Adding '够...的' emphasizes the degree of the situation (awkwardness).

grammar.explanation: The conjunction “而” can be used in a compound sentence to connect two coordinate clauses. It can also be used to indicate an adversative relation.

formal_examples.chinese: “明”字，左边的“日”意思是太阳，而右边的“月”意思是月亮。
formal_examples.pinyin: “Míng” zì, zuǒbian de “rì” yìsi shì tàiyáng, ér yòubian de “yuè” yìsi shì yuèliang.
formal_examples.translation: In the character “明”, the “日” on the left means the sun, while the “月” on the right means the moon.

formal_examples.chinese: 结婚前，我们都要清楚自己想要的是什么，而不要被别人对幸福的看法影响。
formal_examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn qián, wǒmen dōu yào qīngchu zìjǐ xiǎng yào de shì shénme, ér bú yào bèi biéren duì xìngfú de kànfǎ yǐngxiǎng.
formal_examples.translation: Before marriage, we should all be clear about what we want, and not be influenced by other people's views of happiness.

formal_examples.chinese: 在工作中遇到了问题，男人回到家不喜欢跟妻子说，而女人喜欢跟丈夫说。
formal_examples.pinyin: Zài gōngzuò zhōng yùdàole wèntí, nánrén huí dào jiā bù xǐhuan gēn qīzi shuō, ér nǚrén xǐhuan gēn zhàngfu shuō.
formal_examples.translation: When they encounter problems at work, men do not like to talk to their wives after returning home, while women like to talk to their husbands.

formal_examples.chinese: 有些人觉得朋友就是能和自己一起快乐的人，而我的理解是：当你遇到困难的时候，真正的朋友会站出来，及时给你帮助。
formal_examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén juéde péngyou jiùshì néng hé zìjǐ yìqǐ kuàilè de rén, ér wǒ de lǐjiě shì: dāng nǐ yùdào kùnnan de shíhou, zhēnzhèng de péngyou huì zhàn chūlái, jíshí gěi nǐ bāngzhù.
formal_examples.translation: Some people think friends are people who can be happy together with them, but my understanding is: when you encounter difficulties, true friends will stand up and give you help in time.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 大家都忙着玩手机，而他却在一旁安静地看书。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu mángzhe wán shǒujī, ér tā què zài yīpáng ānjìng de kànshū.
colloquial_examples.translation: Everyone is busy playing on their phones, while he is quietly reading a book on the side.

grammar.nuance: '而' is slightly more formal and elegant than '但是' or '可是'. It is often used to create a balanced comparison between two subjects or situations. In daily conversation, it's frequently paired with '却' to strengthen the contrast.

grammar.explanation: Words with the same character “系”: 联系, 关系, 没关系.

formal_examples.chinese:
A: 喂，喂，你在哪儿呢？怎么听不清楚你说话？
B: 我现在在火车站，人太多了，过会儿我再跟你联系吧。
formal_examples.pinyin:
A: Wèi, wèi, nǐ zài nǎr ne? Zěnme tīng bù qīngchu nǐ shuōhuà?
B: Wǒ xiànzài zài huǒchēzhàn, rén tài duō le, guò huìr wǒ zài gēn nǐ liánxì ba.
formal_examples.translation:
A: Hello, hello, where are you? Why can't I hear you clearly?
B: I'm at the train station now. There are too many people. I'll contact you again in a little while.

formal_examples.chinese:
A: 你和她关系那么好，能帮我介绍一下吗？
B: 没问题，下次我们学校开舞会时我叫你来。
formal_examples.pinyin:
A: Nǐ hé tā guānxi nàme hǎo, néng bāng wǒ jièshào yíxià ma?
B: Méi wèntí, xià cì wǒmen xuéxiào kāi wǔhuì shí wǒ jiào nǐ lái.
formal_examples.translation:
A: Your relationship with her is so good. Can you introduce me?
B: No problem. Next time our school holds a dance, I'll invite you.

formal_examples.chinese:
A: 你怎么了？是不是太累了？
B: 我可能有点儿发烧，没关系，休息一下就好了。
formal_examples.pinyin:
A: Nǐ zěnme le? Shì bu shì tài lèi le?
B: Wǒ kěnéng yǒu diǎnr fāshāo, méi guānxi, xiūxi yíxià jiù hǎo le.
formal_examples.translation:
A: What's wrong? Are you too tired?
B: I may have a bit of a fever. It's okay; I'll be fine after resting a little.

grammar.colloquial_pattern: 联系 / 关系 / 没事儿

colloquial_examples.chinese: 这儿太吵了，我一会儿再跟你联系。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Zhèr tài chǎo le, wǒ yíhuìr zài gēn nǐ liánxì.
colloquial_examples.translation: It's too noisy here. I'll get back in touch with you later.

colloquial_examples.chinese: 我有点发烧，没事儿，歇会儿就行。
colloquial_examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu diǎn fāshāo, méi shìr, xiē huìr jiù xíng.
colloquial_examples.translation: I have a bit of a fever, but it's fine. I just need to rest for a bit.

grammar.nuance: This is an expansion note for words sharing the character “系”, not a single grammar pattern. The formal examples preserve the textbook's word-family usage.

key_sentences.sentence: 来中国快一年了，你适应这儿的生活了吗？
key_sentences.pinyin: Lái Zhōngguó kuài yīnián le, nǐ shìyìng zhèr de shēnghuó le ma?
key_sentences.translation: Have you got used to the life here after being in China for nearly a year?
key_sentences.colloquial_equivalent: 来中国也快一年了吧？现在在这边儿还算适应吗？
key_sentences.colloquial_pinyin: Lái Zhōngguó yě kuài yīnián le ba? Xiànzài zài zhèrbianr hái suàn shìyìng ma?
key_sentences.context: Asking whether someone has settled into a new environment.

key_sentences.sentence: 尽管已经毕业这么多年，我们还是经常联系的。
key_sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yǐjīng bìyè zhème duō nián, wǒmen háishì jīngcháng liánxì de.
key_sentences.translation: Although we have been graduated for many years, we still keep in regular contact.
key_sentences.colloquial_equivalent: 虽说毕业好久了，咱俩这关系还是杠杠的，经常联系。
key_sentences.colloquial_pinyin: Suīshuō bìyè hǎojiǔ le, zán liǎ zhè guānxì háishi gànggàng de, jīngcháng liánxì.
key_sentences.context: Emphasizing a friendship that has lasted for years.

key_sentences.sentence: 真正的朋友会站出来，及时给你帮助。
key_sentences.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì zhàn chūlái, jíshí gěi nǐ bāngzhù.
key_sentences.translation: A true friend will stand up and give you timely help.
key_sentences.colloquial_equivalent: 真朋友就是你有事儿的时候，马上站出来拉你一把。
key_sentences.colloquial_pinyin: Zhēn péngyou jiùshì nǐ yǒu shìr de shíhou, mǎshàng zhàn chūlái lā nǐ yī bǎ.
key_sentences.context: Describing what true friendship looks like in a hard moment.

key_sentences.sentence: 每个人都需要朋友，朋友可以丰富我们的生活。
key_sentences.pinyin: Měi gèrén dōu xūyào péngyǒu, péngyǒu kěyǐ fēngfù wǒmen de shēnghuó.
key_sentences.translation: Everyone needs friends, and friends can enrich our lives.
key_sentences.colloquial_equivalent: 人活着哪儿能没朋友啊？有朋友，日子才更有劲儿。
key_sentences.colloquial_pinyin: Rén huózhe nǎr néng méi péngyou a? Yǒu péngyou rìzi cái gèng yǒu jìnr.
key_sentences.context: Talking about why friends make life feel fuller.

key_sentences.sentence: 一个脾气不好的人虽然不一定让人讨厌，但是却很难跟人交朋友。
key_sentences.pinyin: Yīgè píqi bù hǎo de rén suīrán bù yīdìng ràng rén tǎoyàn, dànshì què hěn nán gēn rén jiāo péngyǒu.
key_sentences.translation: Although a person with a bad temper is not necessarily disliked, it is difficult for them to make friends.
key_sentences.colloquial_equivalent: 性格有点儿冲，不等于人人都讨厌你，可朋友确实不太好交。
key_sentences.colloquial_pinyin: Xìngge yǒudiǎn chōu bù děngyú rénrén dōu tǎoyàn nǐ, kě péngyou quèshí bù tài hǎo jiāo.
key_sentences.context: Giving advice about personality and making friends.

texts.title: 小夏和马克聊马克的中国朋友 (xiǎo xià hé mǎ kè liáo mǎ kè de zhōng guó péng yǒu) (Xiao Xia and Mark talk about Mark's Chinese friend)

content.speaker: 小夏
content.text: 来中国快一年了，你适应这儿的生活了吗？
content.pinyin: Lái Zhōngguó kuài yīnián le, nǐ shìyìng zhèr de shēnghuó le ma?
content.translation: You've been in China for almost a year. Have you got used to the life here?

content.speaker: 马克
content.text: 开始有点儿不习惯，后来就慢慢适应了，最近我还交了一个中国朋友。
content.pinyin: Kāishǐ yǒudiǎnr bù xíguàn, hòulái jiù mànman shìyìng le, zuìjìn wǒ hái jiāo le yīgè Zhōngguó péngyǒu.
content.translation: At first, I wasn't used to it, but later I gradually adapted. Recently, I also made a Chinese friend.

content.speaker: 小夏
content.text: 那就好，快给我讲讲你新交的中国朋友。
content.pinyin: Nà jiù hǎo, kuài gěi wǒ jiǎngjiang nǐ xīn jiāo de Zhōngguó péngyǒu.
content.translation: That's good. Tell me about your new Chinese friend.

content.speaker: 马克
content.text: 我们是在图书馆认识的。平时我们常常一起看书、逛街、踢足球。有时候他还给我发一些幽默短信。
content.pinyin: Wǒmen shì zài túshūguǎn rènshi de. Píngshí wǒmen chángcháng yīqǐ kànshū, guàngjiē, tī zúqiú. Yǒushíhòu tā hái gěi wǒ fā yīxiē yōumò duǎnxìn.
content.translation: We met in the library. Normally, we often read books, go shopping, and play football together. Sometimes he also sends me some humorous text messages.

content.speaker: 小夏
content.text: 你的这个朋友真不错！下次介绍我们认识认识，怎么样？

content.translation: No problem! We're going to play football this afternoon, let's go together.

texts.title: 小李和小林聊同学聚会的事情 (xiǎo lǐ hé xiǎo lín liáo tóng xué jù huì de shì qíng) (Xiao Li and Xiao Lin talk about the classmate reunion)

content.speaker: 小李
content.text: 星期天同学聚会，你能来吗？
content.pinyin: Xīngqītiān tóngxué jùhuì, nǐ néng lái ma?
content.translation: There's a classmate reunion on Sunday. Can you come?

content.speaker: 小林
content.text: 能来。班里同学你联系得怎么样了？来多少人？
content.pinyin: Néng lái. Bānlǐ tóngxué nǐ liánxì de zěnmeyàng le? Lái duōshǎo rén?
content.translation: I can. How's the contacting of the classmates going? How many people are coming?

content.speaker: 小李
content.text: 差不多一半儿吧，张远还专门从国外飞回来呢。
content.pinyin: Chàbuduō yībànr ba, Zhāng Yuǎn hái zhuānmén cóng guówài fēi huílái ne.
content.translation: About half, I'd say. Zhang Yuan even specially flew back from abroad.

content.speaker: 小林
content.text: 是吗？毕业都快十年了，真想大家啊！对了，今天早上，我在地铁站遇到了王静，她毕业后就去上海工作了，她这次是来旅游的。
content.pinyin: Shì ma? Bìyè dōu kuài shí nián le, zhēn xiǎng dàjiā a! Duìle, jīntiān zǎoshang, wǒ zài dìtiézhàn yùdào le Wáng Jìng, tā bìyè hòu jiù qù Shànghǎi gōngzuò le, tā zhècì shì lái lǚyóu de.
content.translation: Really? It's been almost ten years since graduation, I really miss everyone! By the way, I met Wang Jing at the subway station this morning. She went to work in Shanghai after graduation, and she's here for a trip this time.

content.speaker: 小李
content.text: 那太好了！麻烦你跟她联系一下，请她一起来参加同学聚会。聚会就在学校门口那个饭店，六点半。别迟到啊！
content.pinyin: Nà tài hǎo le! Máfan nǐ gēn tā liánxì yīxià, qǐng tā yīqǐ lái cānjiā tóngxué jùhuì. Jùhuì jiù zài xuéxiào ménkǒu nàge fàndiàn, liùdiǎn bàn. Bié chídào a!
content.translation: That's great! Could I trouble you to contact her and invite her to join the reunion? The reunion is at the restaurant at the school entrance, at 6:30. Don't be late!

content.speaker: 小林
content.text: 放心吧。星期天六点半见！
content.pinyin: Fàngxīn ba. Xīngqītiān liùdiǎn bàn jiàn!
content.translation: Don't worry. See you at 6:30 on Sunday!

texts.title: 孙月和王静聊她们的朋友 (sūn yuè hé wáng jìng liáo tā men de péng yǒu) (Sun Yue and Wang Jing talk about their friends)

content.speaker: 孙月
content.text: 这是什么时候的照片？你真年轻！
content.pinyin: Zhè shì shénme shíhou de zhàopiàn? Nǐ zhēn niánqīng!
content.translation: When was this photo taken? You look so young!

content.speaker: 王静
content.text: 这是上大学时的照片。一看到这张照片，我就想起过去那段快乐的日子，好像重新回到了校园。
content.pinyin: Zhè shì shàng dàxué shí de zhàopiàn. Yī kàndào zhè zhāng zhàopiàn, wǒ jiù xiǎngqǐ guòqù nà duàn kuàilè de rìzi, hǎoxiàng chóngxīn huídào le xiàoyuán.
content.translation: This is a photo from my university days. As soon as I see this photo, I think of those happy days in the past, as if I've returned to the campus.

content.speaker: 孙月
content.text: 旁边这个人一定是你的好朋友吧？你们现在还联系吗？
content.pinyin: Pángbiān zhège rén yīdìng shì nǐ de hǎo péngyǒu ba? Nǐmen xiànzài hái liánxì ma?
content.translation: The person next to you must be your good friend, right? Are you still in contact?

content.speaker: 王静
content.text: 当然了，尽管已经毕业这么多年，我们还是经常联系的，每次都有说不完的话。
content.pinyin: Dāngrán le, jǐn'guǎn yǐjīng bìyè zhème duō nián, wǒmen háishì jīngcháng liánxì de, měicì dōu yǒu shuō bù wán de huà.
content.translation: Of course. Although it's been many years since graduation, we are still in regular contact. Every time we talk, we have endless things to say.

content.speaker: 孙月
content.text: 真羡慕你！我上大学时最好的朋友去了南方工作，我们俩已经好久没联系了。我一会儿就给她打个电话。
content.pinyin: Zhēn xiànmù nǐ! Wǒ shàng dàxué shí zuì hǎo de péngyǒu qù le nánfāng gōngzuò, wǒmen liǎ yǐjīng hǎojiǔ méi liánxì le. Wǒ yīhuìr jù gěi tā dǎ gè diànhuà.
content.translation: I really envy you! My best friend from university went to work in the south, and we haven't been in contact for a long time. I'll give her a call in a bit.

content.speaker: 王静
content.text: 对。要知道，能有一个真正的朋友，有一段真正的友谊，是多么不容易！
content.pinyin: Duì. Yào zhīdào, néng yǒu yīgè zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu, yǒu yīduàn zhēnzhèng de yǒuyì, shì duōme bù róngyì!
content.translation: Right. You know, having a true friend and a true friendship is not easy at all!

texts.title: 丰富生活 (fēng fù shēng huó) (Enriching Life - Monologue)

content.speaker: 独白
content.text: 每个人都需要朋友，朋友可以丰富我们的生活。离开朋友，我们的生活一定会非常无聊。那么，怎样才能交到更多的朋友呢？当然，要有好脾气. 一个脾气不好的人虽然不一定让人讨厌，但是却很难跟人交朋友. 因为没有人会喜欢跟一个总是容易生气的人在一起. 我们还要经常跟周围的人交流. 交流能让人们互相了解, 如果有共同的兴趣、爱好或者习惯，就更容易成为朋友了。
content.pinyin: Měi gèrén dōu xūyào péngyǒu, péngyǒu kěyǐ fēngfù wǒmen de shēnghuó. Líkāi péngyǒu, wǒmen de shēnghuó yīdìng huì fēicháng wúliáo. Nàme, zěnyàng cáinéng jiāo dào gèng duō de péngyǒu ne? Dāngrán, yào yǒu hǎo píqi. Yīgè píqi bù hǎo de rén suīrán bù yīdìng ràng rén tǎoyàn, dànshì què hěn nán gēn rén jiāo péngyǒu. Yīnwèi méiyǒu rén huì xǐhuān gēn yīgè zǒngshì róngyì shēngqì de rén zài yīqǐ. Wǒmen hái yào jīngcháng gēn zhōuwéi de rén jiāoliú. Jiāoliú néng ràng rénmen hùxiāng liǎojiě, rúguǒ yǒu gòngtóng de xìngqù, àihào huòzhě xíguàn, jiù gèng róngyì chéngwéi péngyǒu le.
content.translation: Everyone needs friends, and friends can enrich our lives. Without friends, our lives will definitely be very boring. So, how can we make more friends? Of course, you need to have a good temper. Although a person with a bad temper may not necessarily be disliked, it is difficult for them to make friends. This is because no one likes to be with someone who gets angry easily. We should also frequently communicate with the people around us. Communication allows people to understand each other; if there are common interests, hobbies, or habits, it becomes easier to become friends.

texts.title: 什么是真正的朋友 (shén me shì zhēn zhèng de péng yǒu) (What is a True Friend - Monologue)

content.speaker: 独白
content.text: 人的一生可以什么都没有，但不能没有朋友，而且必须要有自己真正的朋友。什么是真正的朋友？不同的人会有不同的理解。有些人觉得朋友就是能和自己一起快乐的人；有些人觉得朋友应该像镜子，能帮自己看到缺点。而我的理解是：当你遇到困难的时候，真正的朋友会站出来，及时给你帮助；当你无聊或者难过的时候，真正的朋友会陪在你身边，想办法让你感到幸福。
content.pinyin: Rén de yīshēng kěyǐ shénme dōu méiyǒu, dàn bùnéng méiyǒu péngyǒu, érqiě bìxū yào yǒu zìjǐ zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu. Shénme shì zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu? Bùtóng de rén huì yǒu bùtóng de lǐjiě. Yǒuxiē rén juédé péngyǒu jiùshì néng hé zìjǐ yīqǐ kuàilè de rén; yǒuxiē rén juédé péngyǒu yīnggāi xiàng jìngzi, néng bāng zìjǐ kàndào quēdiǎn. Ér wǒ de lǐjiě shì: Dāng nǐ yùdào kùnnan de shíhou, zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì zhàn chūlái, jíshí gěi nǐ bāngzhù; dāng nǐ wúliáo huòzhě nánguò de shíhou, zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì péi zài nǐ shēnbiān, xiǎng bànfǎ ràng nǐ gǎndào xìngfú.
content.translation: A person can have nothing in their life, but they cannot be without friends, and they must have their own true friends. What is a true friend? Different people have different understandings. Some people feel that a friend is someone who can be happy with them; some feel that a friend should be like a mirror, helping them see their shortcomings. But my understanding is: when you encounter difficulties, a true friend will stand up and give you timely help; when you are bored or sad, a true friend will stay by your side and find ways to make you feel happy.

translation.ko: 우리 오후에 축구 하러 가는데, 너 마침 잘 왔다. 같이 가자.

formal_translation.ko: “差不多”는 형용사로 쓰여 ‘비슷하다, 차이가 크지 않다’를 뜻할 수 있습니다. 또한 부사로 쓰여 정도, 범위, 시간, 거리, 수량 등이 매우 가까움을 나타낼 수 있습니다.
formal_translation.ja: 「差不多」は形容詞として「近い、あまり差がない」という意味を表すことができます。また副詞として、程度、範囲、時間、距離、数量などが近いことを表すこともできます。
formal_translation.en: “差不多” can be used as an adjective to mean “approximate” and “without much difference”. It can also be used as an adverb to indicate being close in terms of degree, scope, time, distance or quantity.

colloquial_translation.ko: 과 애들한테 연락 다 돌렸어? 얼마나 온대? 대충 절반은 올걸.
colloquial_translation.ja: クラスのみんなに連絡ついた？何人くらい来れそう？まあ、ざっと半分ってとこかな。
colloquial_translation.en: '大差不差' is a more northern, idiomatic way to say 'almost there' or 'pretty much' in a colloquial setting.

translation.ko: 이 두 전자사전은 보기에 비슷한데, 왼쪽 것은 왜 이렇게 비싼가요?
translation.ja: この二つの電子辞書は見たところほとんど同じなのに、左のものはどうしてこんなに高いのですか。
translation.en: These two electronic dictionaries look about the same. Why is the one on the left so expensive?

translation.ko: 그 두 사람은 해외여행 중에 알게 되었고, 성격이 비슷해서 곧 좋은 친구가 되었습니다.
translation.ja: 二人は海外旅行中に知り合い、性格が似ていたので、すぐに良い友達になりました。
translation.en: The two of them met while traveling abroad. Their personalities are similar, so they quickly became good friends.

translation.ko:
A: 반 친구들과 연락은 어떻게 되었나요? 몇 명이나 오나요?
B: 거의 절반 정도일 거예요.
translation.ja:
A: クラスメートへの連絡はどうなりましたか。何人くらい来ますか。
B: だいたい半分くらいでしょう。
translation.en:

B: About half, I guess.

translation.ko: 딸이 중학교에 들어간 뒤 키가 아주 빨리 자라서, 지금은 거의 1미터 70이고 저와 비슷한 키가 되었습니다.
translation.ja: 娘は中学校に入ってから背がとても速く伸び、今ではもうすぐ1メートル70で、私とほとんど同じ高さになりました。
translation.en: After my daughter started middle school, she grew very quickly. Now she is almost 1.7 meters tall, about as tall as me.

translation.ko: 반 친구들에게 거의 연락이 됐고, 기본적으로 절반 정도는 올 수 있어요.
translation.ja: クラスのみんなにはだいたい連絡がついて、基本的に半分くらいは来られます。
translation.en: The classmates are mostly contacted, basically about half can come.

formal_translation.ko: 공통점: “差不多”와 “几乎”는 모두 부사로서 매우 가깝거나 비슷함을 나타내며 부사어가 될 수 있습니다. 차이점: 이 뜻을 나타낼 때 “差不多”는 단음절 형용사 바로 앞에 올 수 있지만, “几乎” 뒤의 형용사 앞뒤에는 다른 말이 필요합니다. “差不多”는 수량사 앞에 와서 그 수량에 가까움을 나타낼 수 있지만 “几乎”에는 이런 용법이 없습니다. “差不多”는 형용사로 술어가 되어 차이가 크지 않음을 나타낼 수 있지만 “几乎”에는 이런 용법이 없습니다. “几乎”는 원하지 않는 일이 거의 일어날 뻔했지만 결국 일어나지 않았음을 나타낼 수 있고, “差不多”에는 이런 용법이 없습니다.
formal_translation.ja: 共通点: 「差不多」と「几乎」はどちらも副詞で、とても近い、または似ていることを表し、連用修飾語として使えます。違い: この意味を表すとき、「差不多」は単音節形容詞の直前に置けますが、「几乎」の後の形容詞の前後には他の語が必要です。「差不多」は数量詞の前に置いてその数量に近いことを表せますが、「几乎」にはその用法がありません。「差不多」は形容詞として述語になり、差が大きくないことを表せますが、「几乎」にはその用法がありません。「几乎」は望ましくないことがほとんど起こりかけたが結局起こらなかったことを表せますが、「差不多」にはその用法がありません。
formal_translation.en: Similarity: both “差不多” and “几乎” are adverbs indicating being very close or similar, and both can serve as an adverbial modifier. Differences: when expressing this meaning, “差不多” can be used directly before a monosyllabic adjective, while the adjective before or after “几乎” needs other words. “差不多” can precede a numeral-classifier compound to indicate being close to that quantity, while “几乎” has no such usage. “差不多” can also be used as an adjective predicate to indicate being similar and without much difference, while “几乎” has no such usage. “几乎” can indicate that something undesirable almost happened but finally did not, while “差不多” has no such usage.

colloquial_translation.ko: 와, 얘 중국어 진짜 잘한다. 거의 중국 사람인 줄 알겠어. 아, 맞다! 하마터면 너한테 이 얘기 하는 거 까먹을 뻔했네.
colloquial_translation.ja: うわ、彼中国語めちゃくちゃ上手いね。もう中国人かと思ったよ。あ、いっけな！君にこのこと言うの、危うく忘れるところだった。
colloquial_translation.en: This is a comparison note rather than a single new pattern. “差不多” can describe similarity or approximate quantity more freely, while “几乎” is better for “almost” as an adverb, especially when something nearly happened.

translation.ko: 그는 중국어를 아주 잘해서 거의 중국인과 같습니다.
translation.ja: 彼は中国語がとても上手で、ほとんど中国人と同じです。
translation.en: He speaks Chinese very well, almost like a Chinese person.

translation.ko: 그 두 사람은 키가 비슷합니다.
translation.ja: 二人はだいたい同じくらいの高さです。
translation.en: The two of them are about the same height.

translation.ko: 그 두 사람은 거의 같은 키입니다.
translation.ja: 二人はほとんど同じ高さです。
translation.en: The two of them are almost the same height.

translation.ko: 그는 저보다 거의 머리 하나만큼 큽니다.
translation.ja: 彼は私よりほとんど頭一つ分高いです。
translation.en: He is almost a head taller than me.

translation.ko: 리 선생님은 거의 예순 살입니다.
translation.ja: 李先生はもうすぐ六十歳です。
translation.en: Teacher Li is almost sixty years old.

translation.ko: 자매 두 사람은 성격이 비슷합니다.
translation.ja: 姉妹二人は性格が似ています。
translation.en: The two sisters have similar personalities.

translation.ko: 이 일을 당신에게 말하는 것을 거의 잊을 뻔했습니다.
translation.ja: このことをあなたに伝えるのをほとんど忘れるところでした。
translation.en: I almost forgot to tell you about this.

translation.ko: 아차, 이 일을 너한테 말하는 걸 하마터면 까먹을 뻔했어.
translation.ja: あ、危ない。このことを君に言うのをうっかり忘れるところだった。
translation.en: Oops, I almost forgot to tell you about this matter.

formal_translation.ko: 비록 졸업한 지 이렇게 오래되었지만, 우리는 여전히 자주 연락한다.
formal_translation.ja: 卒業してもう何年も経つが、私たちは今でもよく連絡を取り合っている。
formal_translation.en: The conjunction “尽管” is usually used in the first clause of a complex sentence to state a fact, often coordinating with words indicating transition such as “但是/可是/却/还是” in the second clause, which introduces a result that would not occur under normal circumstances.

colloquial_translation.ko: 졸업한 지가 언젠데, 우리 사이는 아직도 짱짱해. 자주 보거든.
colloquial_translation.ja: 卒業してから随分経つけど、うちらの仲は相変わらずだよ。しょっちゅう会ってるしね。
colloquial_translation.en: '虽说' is a very common oral substitute for '尽管' or '虽然'. Adding '杠杠的' (slang for excellent/solid) makes the sentence sound like a real conversation between close friends.

translation.ko: 비록 졸업한 지 이렇게 오래되었지만, 우리는 여전히 자주 연락합니다.
translation.ja: 卒業してもう何年も経ちますが、私たちは今でもよく連絡を取り合っています。
translation.en: Although we have been graduated for many years, we still keep in regular contact.

translation.ko: 남자친구가 준 이 선물은 비싸지 않지만, 저를 매우 감동시켰습니다.
translation.ja: 彼氏がくれたこのプレゼントは高くありませんが、私をとても感動させました。
translation.en: Although the gift my boyfriend gave me was not expensive, it moved me very much.

translation.ko: 삼촌의 가장 큰 취미는 농구입니다. 대학 때 그는 학교 농구 경기에 여러 번 참가했습니다. 지금은 일이 매우 바쁘지만, 주말이 되면 여전히 친구들과 농구를 하러 갑니다.
translation.ja: 叔父の一番の趣味はバスケットボールです。大学時代には学校のバスケットボールの試合に何度も参加しました。今は仕事がとても忙しいですが、週末になるとやはり友達とバスケットボールをしに行きます。
translation.en: My uncle's biggest hobby is playing basketball, and in college he participated in school basketball games many times. Although he is very busy with work now, on weekends he still goes to play basketball with friends.

translation.ko: 졸업한 지 오래됐지만, 우리 사이는 아직도 아주 좋고 자주 만나요.
translation.ja: 卒業してずいぶん経ちますが、私たちの関係は今でもとても良く、よく会っています。
translation.en: Even though we graduated ages ago, our relationship is still solid; we get together often.

formal_translation.ko: 성격이 좋지 않은 사람이 반드시 미움을 받는 것은 아니지만, 친구를 사귀기는 매우 어렵다.
formal_translation.ja: 性格が良くない人が必ずしも嫌われるわけではないが、友達を作るのは非常に難しい。
formal_translation.en: The adverb “却” is used after the subject and before the verb to indicate a transition in meaning in a softer tone.

colloquial_translation.ko: 성격 안 좋다고 다들 싫어하는 건 아닌데, 친구 사귀기는 확실히 좀 힘들지.
colloquial_translation.ja: 性格に難があるからって皆に嫌われるとは限らないけど、友達作りとなると話は別だよね。
colloquial_translation.en: In spoken Chinese, '倒' is often used similarly to '却' to express something unexpected or contrary to expectation. Adding '够...的' emphasizes the degree of the situation (awkwardness).

translation.ko: 어떤 사람은 집과 자동차가 있으면 행복이라고 생각하지만, 어떤 사람은 진정한 사랑을 찾는 것이 행복이라고 생각합니다.
translation.ja: 家や車があれば幸せだと思う人もいれば、本当の愛を見つけることこそ幸せだと思う人もいます。
translation.en: Some people think having a house and a car is happiness, while others believe finding true love is happiness.

translation.ko: 성격이 좋지 않은 사람이 반드시 미움을 받는 것은 아니지만, 친구를 사귀기는 매우 어렵습니다.
translation.ja: 性格が良くない人が必ずしも嫌われるわけではありませんが、友達を作るのはとても難しいです。
translation.en: Although a person with a bad temper is not necessarily disliked, it is difficult for them to make friends.

translation.ko: 요즘 많은 사람은 같은 건물에 살지만, 한 번도 말을 나눈 적이 없습니다.
translation.ja: 今では多くの人が同じ建物に住んでいるのに、一度も話したことがありません。
translation.en: Nowadays, many people live in the same building, yet they have never spoken to each other.

translation.ko: 몇 년 동안 맞은편에 살았는데도 인사 한 번 안 했다니, 정말 좀 어색하네요.
translation.ja: 向かいに何年も住んでいるのに、挨拶すらしたことがないなんて、本当に気まずいですね。
translation.en: Living across from each other for years, yet not even a greeting was exchanged; it's quite awkward.

formal_translation.ko: 어떤 이들은 친구가 자신과 함께 즐거울 수 있는 사람이라고 생각하지만, 나의 이해는 이렇다: 당신이 어려움에 처했을 때, 진정한 친구는 발 벗고 나서서 제때 도움을 주는 사람이다.
formal_translation.ja: ある人は友達を自分と一緒に楽しく過ごせる人だと考えるが、私の理解はこうだ：困難に直面したとき、本当の友達は立ち上がって、タイミングよく助けてくれるものだ。
formal_translation.en: The conjunction “而” can be used in a compound sentence to connect two coordinate clauses. It can also be used to indicate an adversative relation.

colloquial_translation.ko: 친구라는 게 같이 놀 때만 좋은 사람도 있겠지만, 내가 생각하는 진짜 친구는 말이야, 힘들 때 딱 나타나서 도와주는 그런 사람이야.
colloquial_translation.ja: 友達ってのは一緒に遊んで楽しいだけの人もいるだろうけどさ、私が思う本当の友達ってのは、困った時にパッと現れて助けてくれる、そんな人のことだよ。
colloquial_translation.en: '而' is slightly more formal and elegant than '但是' or '可是'. It is often used to create a balanced comparison between two subjects or situations. In daily conversation, it's frequently paired with '却' to strengthen the contrast.

translation.ko: ‘明’ 자에서 왼쪽의 ‘日’은 태양을 뜻하고, 오른쪽의 ‘月’은 달을 뜻합니다.
translation.ja: 「明」という字では、左側の「日」は太陽を意味し、右側の「月」は月を意味します。
translation.en: In the character “明”, the “日” on the left means the sun, while the “月” on the right means the moon.

translation.ko: 결혼하기 전에 우리는 자신이 원하는 것이 무엇인지 분명히 알아야 하며, 다른 사람의 행복에 대한 생각에 영향을 받아서는 안 됩니다.
translation.ja: 結婚前に、私たちは自分が何を望んでいるのかをはっきり知り、他人の幸福に対する考えに影響されないようにすべきです。
translation.en: Before marriage, we should all be clear about what we want, and not be influenced by other people's views of happiness.

translation.ko: 일에서 문제를 만나면 남자는 집에 돌아와 아내에게 말하기를 좋아하지 않지만, 여자는 남편에게 말하기를 좋아합니다.
translation.ja: 仕事で問題に出会うと、男性は家に帰って妻に話したがりませんが、女性は夫に話したがります。
translation.en: When they encounter problems at work, men do not like to talk to their wives after returning home, while women like to talk to their husbands.

translation.ko: 어떤 사람은 친구란 자신과 함께 즐거울 수 있는 사람이라고 생각하지만, 제 이해는 이렇습니다. 어려움을 만났을 때 진정한 친구는 나서서 제때 도움을 줍니다.
translation.ja: 友達とは自分と一緒に楽しく過ごせる人だと思う人もいますが、私の理解はこうです。困難に出会ったとき、本当の友達は立ち上がって、すぐに助けてくれます。
translation.en: Some people think friends are people who can be happy together with them, but my understanding is: when you encounter difficulties, true friends will stand up and give you help in time.

translation.ko: 다들 휴대폰을 하느라 바쁜데, 그는 옆에서 조용히 책을 읽고 있어요.
translation.ja: みんなスマホで忙しいのに、彼はそばで静かに本を読んでいます。
translation.en: Everyone is busy playing on their phones, while he is quietly reading a book on the side.

formal_translation.ko: 같은 글자 '系'를 포함한 단어: 联系, 关系, 没关系.
formal_translation.ja: 同じ字「系」を含む語: 联系、关系、没关系。
formal_translation.en: Words with the same character “系”: 联系, 关系, 没关系.

colloquial_translation.ko: 이 항목은 하나의 문법 패턴이 아니라 '系'가 들어간 단어군 확장 노트입니다.
colloquial_translation.ja: これは一つの文法パターンではなく、「系」を含む語群の拡張ノートです。
colloquial_translation.en: This is an expansion note for words sharing the character “系”, not a single grammar pattern. The formal examples preserve the textbook's word-family usage.

translation.ko:
A: 여보세요, 여보세요, 어디에 있어요? 왜 말을 잘 들을 수 없죠?
B: 저는 지금 기차역에 있어요. 사람이 너무 많아서 조금 있다가 다시 연락할게요.
translation.ja:
A: もしもし、もしもし、どこにいるのですか。どうして話がよく聞こえないのですか。
B: 今駅にいます。人が多すぎるので、少ししたらまた連絡します。
translation.en:
A: Hello, hello, where are you? Why can't I hear you clearly?
B: I'm at the train station now. There are too many people. I'll contact you again in a little while.

translation.ko:
A: 당신은 그녀와 관계가 그렇게 좋은데, 저를 좀 소개해 줄 수 있나요?
B: 문제없어요. 다음에 우리 학교에서 무도회가 열릴 때 당신을 부를게요.
translation.ja:
A: あなたは彼女とそんなに仲が良いのだから、私に紹介してくれませんか。
B: 問題ありません。次に私たちの学校でダンスパーティーがあるとき、あなたを呼びます。
translation.en:
A: Your relationship with her is so good. Can you introduce me?
B: No problem. Next time our school holds a dance, I'll invite you.

translation.ko:
A: 왜 그래요? 너무 피곤한가요?
B: 열이 조금 나는 것 같아요. 괜찮아요. 좀 쉬면 나을 거예요.
translation.ja:
A: どうしましたか。疲れすぎたのですか。
B: 少し熱があるかもしれません。大丈夫です。少し休めばよくなります。
translation.en:
A: What's wrong? Are you too tired?
B: I may have a bit of a fever. It's okay; I'll be fine after resting a little.

translation.ko: 여기 너무 시끄러워요. 나중에 다시 연락할게요.
translation.ja: ここはうるさすぎます。あとでまた連絡します。
translation.en: It's too noisy here. I'll get back in touch with you later.

translation.ko: 열이 조금 나지만 괜찮아요. 잠깐 쉬면 돼요.
translation.ja: 少し熱がありますが、大丈夫です。少し休めばいいです。
translation.en: I have a bit of a fever, but it's fine. I just need to rest for a bit.

translation.ko: 중국에 온 지 곧 1년이 되는데, 이곳 생활에 적응했니?
translation.ja: 中国に来てそろそろ一年になるけど、ここの生活には慣れた？
translation.en: Have you got used to the life here after being in China for nearly a year?

colloquial_translation.ko: 중국 온 지도 벌써 1년 다 돼가네. 이제 좀 살만해?
colloquial_translation.ja: 中国に来てからもうすぐ一年だね。こっちの生活、馴染んできた？
colloquial_translation.en: You've been in China almost a year now. Settling in okay?

context.ja: 相手の適応具合を尋ねるとき。
context.en: Asking whether someone has settled into a new environment.

translation.ko: 비록 졸업한 지 이렇게 오래되었지만, 우리는 여전히 자주 연락한다.
translation.ja: 卒業してもう何年も経つけど、私たちは今でもよく連絡を取り合っている。
translation.en: Although we have been graduated for many years, we still keep in regular contact.

colloquial_translation.ko: 졸업하고 한참 지났는데도 우린 여전히 자주 연락하고 지내.
colloquial_translation.ja: 卒業して随分経つのに、今でもしょっちゅう連絡取り合ってるんだ。
colloquial_translation.en: It's been ages since graduation, but we're still super close and talk all the time.

context.ja: 長い友情を強調するとき。
context.en: Emphasizing a friendship that has lasted for years.

translation.ko: 진정한 친구는 발 벗고 나서서 제때 도움을 준다.
translation.ja: 本当の友達は立ち上がって、タイミングよく助けてくれるものだ。
translation.en: A true friend will stand up and give you timely help.

colloquial_translation.ko: 진짜 친구라면 어려울 때 딱 나타나서 도와줘야지.
colloquial_translation.ja: 本当の友達なら、いざという時にパッと助けてくれないとね。
colloquial_translation.en: A real friend shows up right when things get tough and helps you out.

context.ja: 真の友情の定義を語るとき。
context.en: Describing what true friendship looks like in a hard moment.

translation.ko: 누구나 친구가 필요하며, 친구는 우리의 삶을 풍요롭게 해 준다.
translation.ja: 誰にでも友達は必要で、友達は私たちの生活を豊かにしてくれる。
translation.en: Everyone needs friends, and friends can enrich our lives.

colloquial_translation.ko: 사람한테 친구가 없으면 안 돼. 친구가 있어야 사는 게 즐겁지.
colloquial_translation.ja: 人間、友達がいないとね。友達のおかげで人生が豊かになるんだ。
colloquial_translation.en: You really can't do without friends. They're what make life fun.

context.ja: 友達の大切さを語るとき。
context.en: Talking about why friends make life feel fuller.

translation.ko: 성격이 좋지 않은 사람이 반드시 미움을 받는 것은 아니지만, 친구를 사귀기는 매우 어렵다.
translation.ja: 性格が良くない人が必ずしも嫌われるわけではないが、友達を作るのは非常に難しい。
translation.en: Although a person with a bad temper is not necessarily disliked, it is difficult for them to make friends.

colloquial_translation.ko: 성격 좀 까칠하다고 다 싫어하는 건 아니지만, 친구 사귀기는 확실히 어렵긴 해.
colloquial_translation.ja: 性格がキツいからって嫌われるとは限らないけど、友達を作るのはやっぱり大変だよね。
colloquial_translation.en: Being a little prickly doesn't mean everyone will hate you, but it definitely makes friendship harder.

context.ko: 성격과 교우 관계에 대해 조언할 때.
context.ja: 性格と友人関係について助言するとき。
context.en: Giving advice about personality and making friends.

translation.ko: 중국에 온 지 곧 1년이 되는데, 이곳 생활에 적응했니?
translation.ja: 中国に来てそろそろ一年になるけど、ここの生活には慣れた？
translation.en: You've been in China for almost a year. Have you got used to the life here?

translation.ko: 처음에는 좀 익숙하지 않았는데, 나중에는 천천히 적응했어. 최근에는 중국 친구도 한 명 사귀었어.
translation.ja: 最初は慣れなかったけど、後からだんだん適応してきたよ。最近は中国人の友達も一人できたんだ。
translation.en: At first, I wasn't used to it, but later I gradually adapted. Recently, I also made a Chinese friend.

translation.ko: 그거 잘됐네! 새로 사귄 중국 친구 이야기 좀 해줘.
translation.ja: それは良かった！新しくできた中国人の友達のこと、早く教えてよ。
translation.en: That's good. Tell me about your new Chinese friend.

translation.ko: 우리 도서관에서 알게 됐어. 평소에 우리는 자주 같이 책도 보고, 쇼핑도 하고, 축구도 해. 가끔은 그가 유머러스한 문자 메시지도 보내줘.
translation.ja: 図書館で知り合ったんだ。普段、僕たちはよく一緒に本を読んだり、買い物に行ったり、サッカーをしたりしてるよ。時々、彼が面白いメールを送ってくれることもあるんだ。
translation.en: We met in the library. Normally, we often read books, go shopping, and play football together. Sometimes he also sends me some humorous text messages.

translation.ko: 네 친구 정말 괜찮네! 다음에 우리도 인사 시켜줘, 어때?
translation.ja: その友達、すごくいいね！今度紹介してよ、どうかな？
translation.en: This friend of yours is really good! How about introducing us next time?

translation.ko: 문제없지! 우리 오후에 축구 하러 갈 건데, 마침 잘 됐네, 같이 가자.
translation.ja: いいよ！午後からサッカーに行くんだ、ちょうどいいから一緒に行こうよ。
translation.en: No problem! We're going to play football this afternoon, let's go together.

translation.ko: 일요일에 동창회 하는데, 너 올 수 있어?
translation.ja: 日曜日に同窓会があるんだけど、来られる？
translation.en: There's a classmate reunion on Sunday. Can you come?

translation.ko: 갈 수 있지. 반 친구들한테는 연락이 어떻게 됐어? 몇 명이나 온대?
translation.ja: 行けるよ。クラスの皆への連絡はどうなった？何人くらい来るかな？
translation.en: I can. How's the contacting of the classmates going? How many people are coming?

translation.ko: 거의 절반 정도 올 거야. 장위안은 특별히 외국에서 비행기 타고 돌아온대.
translation.ja: だいたい半分くらいかな。張遠なんて、わざわざ海外から飛行機で戻ってくるんだよ。
translation.en: About half, I'd say. Zhang Yuan even specially flew back from abroad.

translation.ko: 그래? 졸업한 지 곧 10년인데, 다들 정말 보고 싶다! 아 참, 오늘 아침에 지하철역에서 왕징을 만났어. 그녀는 졸업 후에 상하이로 가서 일했는데, 이번에는 여행하러 왔대.
translation.ja: そうなの？卒業してもうすぐ10年だもんね、皆に本当に会いたいな！あ、そうだ、今朝地下鉄の駅で王静に会ったよ。彼女、卒業後は上海に行って働いてたんだけど、今回は旅行で来てるんだって。
translation.en: Really? It's been almost ten years since graduation, I really miss everyone! By the way, I met Wang Jing at the subway station this morning. She went to work in Shanghai after graduation, and she's here for a trip this time.

translation.ko: 와 잘됐다! 번거롭겠지만 그녀에게 연락 좀 해서 동창회에 같이 오라고 해줘. 모임은 학교 정문 앞 식당에서 6시 반이야. 늦지 마!
translation.ja: それはすごい！お手数だけど彼女に連絡して、同窓会に一緒に来るよう誘ってよ。同窓会は学校の正門前のレストランで、6時半からだよ。遅れないでね！
translation.en: That's great! Could I trouble you to contact her and invite her to join the reunion? The reunion is at the restaurant at the school entrance, at 6:30. Don't be late!

translation.ko: 걱정 마. 일요일 6시 반에 봐!
translation.ja: 任せて。日曜日、6時半に会おう！
translation.en: Don't worry. See you at 6:30 on Sunday!

translation.ko: 이건 언제 찍은 사진이야? 너 정말 젊다!
translation.ja: これはいつの写真？すごく若いね！
translation.en: When was this photo taken? You look so young!

translation.ko: 이건 대학교 때 사진이야. 이 사진만 보면 예전의 그 즐거웠던 날들이 생각나서, 마치 다시 캠퍼스로 돌아간 것 같아.
translation.ja: これは大学時代の写真だよ。この写真を見るたびに、昔のあの楽しかった日々を思い出して、まるで大学に戻ったような気分になるんだ。
translation.en: This is a photo from my university days. As soon as I see this photo, I think of those happy days in the past, as if I've returned to the campus.

translation.ko: 옆에 이 사람은 분명 네 친한 친구지? 너희 지금도 연락하니?
translation.ja: 隣のこの人は、きっと親友だよね？今でも連絡取り合ってるの？
translation.en: The person next to you must be your good friend, right? Are you still in contact?

translation.ko: 당연하지. 비록 졸업한 지 이렇게 오래되었지만, 우리는 여전히 자주 연락해. 만날 때마다 할 말이 끝이 없다니까.
translation.ja: もちろんだよ。卒業してもう何年も経つけど、今でもしょっちゅう連絡してるよ。会うたびに話が尽きないんだ。
translation.en: Of course. Although it's been many years since graduation, we are still in regular contact. Every time we talk, we have endless things to say.

translation.ko: 정말 부럽다! 내가 대학교 때 가장 친했던 친구는 남쪽으로 일하러 가서 우리 둘은 한참 동안 연락을 못 했어. 이따가 그녀에게 전화 한 통 해봐야겠다.
translation.ja: 本当にうらやましい！私が大学時代一番仲が良かった友達は南の方へ働きに行って、二人でもう長いこと連絡取ってないんだ。後で彼女に電話してみようかな。
translation.en: I really envy you! My best friend from university went to work in the south, and we haven't been in contact for a long time. I'll give her a call in a bit.

translation.ko: 그래. 진정한 친구 한 명, 진정한 우정 하나를 갖는다는 게 얼마나 쉽지 않은 일인지 알아야 해!
translation.ja: そうだね。一人の本当の友達、一つの本当の友情を持つことがどれほど簡単じゃないか、分かっておかないとね！
translation.en: Right. You know, having a true friend and a true friendship is not easy at all!

translation.ko: 누구나 친구가 필요하며, 친구는 우리의 삶을 풍요롭게 해 준다. 친구를 떠나면 우리의 삶은 분명 매우 무료해질 것이다. 그렇다면 어떻게 해야 더 많은 친구를 사귈 수 있을까? 물론 좋은 성격을 가져야 한다. 성격이 좋지 않은 사람이 반드시 미움을 받는 것은 아니지만, 친구를 사귀기는 매우 어렵다. 왜냐하면 아무도 늘 쉽게 화를 내는 사람과 함께 있고 싶어 하지 않기 때문이다. 우리는 또한 주변 사람들과 자주 소통해야 한다. 소통은 사람들이 서로를 이해하게 해 주며, 공통의 관심사나 취미, 습관이 있다면 친구가 되기 더 쉽다.
translation.ja: 誰にでも友達は必要で、友達は私たちの生活を豊かにしてくれる。友達がいなくなれば、私たちの生活はきっと非常に退屈なものになるだろう。では、どうすればもっと多くの友達を作ることができるだろうか。もちろん、良い性格を持つ必要がある。性格が良くない人が必ずしも嫌われるわけではないが、友達を作るのは非常に難しい。なぜなら、いつも怒りやすい人と一緒にいたいと思う人はいないからだ。また、私たちは周囲の人々と頻繁に交流する必要がある。交流は人々がお互いを理解することを可能にし、共通の興味や趣味、習慣があれば、友達になりやすくなるのだ。
translation.en: Everyone needs friends, and friends can enrich our lives. Without friends, our lives will definitely be very boring. So, how can we make more friends? Of course, you need to have a good temper. Although a person with a bad temper may not necessarily be disliked, it is difficult for them to make friends. This is because no one likes to be with someone who gets angry easily. We should also frequently communicate with the people around us. Communication allows people to understand each other; if there are common interests, hobbies, or habits, it becomes easier to become friends.

translation.ko: 사람은 인생에서 아무것도 없을 수 있지만, 친구가 없을 수는 없으며, 반드시 자신만의 진정한 친구가 있어야 한다. 진정한 친구란 무엇일까? 사람마다 이해하는 바가 다를 것이다. 어떤 이들은 친구가 자신과 함께 즐거울 수 있는 사람이라고 생각하고, 어떤 이들은 친구가 거울처럼 자신의 단점을 보게 도와주는 사람이어야 한다고 생각한다. 하지만 나의 이해는 이렇다: 당신이 어려움에 처했을 때, 진정한 친구는 발 벗고 나서서 제때 도움을 주는 사람이다. 당신이 무료하거나 슬플 때, 진정한 친구는 곁에 있어 주며 당신을 행복하게 해 줄 방법을 찾는 사람이다.
translation.ja: 人は一生のうちに何も持たなくてもいいが、友達がいないわけにはいかない。そして、自分だけの本当の友達が必ず必要だ。本当の友達とは何だろうか。人によって理解は異なるだろう。ある人は友達を自分と一緒に楽しく過ごせる人だと考え、ある人は友達が鏡のように自分の短所を見るのを助けてくれる人であるべきだと考える。しかし、私の理解はこうだ：困難に直面したとき、本当の友達は立ち上がって、タイミングよく助けてくれるものだ。退屈な時や悲しい時、本当の友達はそばにいてくれて、あなたを幸せにする方法を考えてくれる人である。
translation.en: A person can have nothing in their life, but they cannot be without friends, and they must have their own true friends. What is a true friend? Different people have different understandings. Some people feel that a friend is someone who can be happy with them; some feel that a friend should be like a mirror, helping them see their shortcomings. But my understanding is: when you encounter difficulties, a true friend will stand up and give you timely help; when you are bored or sad, a true friend will stay by your side and find ways to make you feel happy.
